# Support

## How to get help

- [Open an issue](https://github.com/stoe/skill-authoring/issues/new) for bug reports and feature requests.
- [Start a discussion](https://github.com/stoe/skill-authoring/discussions) for usage questions and general guidance, when discussions are enabled.
- Include enough context to make the request actionable.

For faster triage, include:

- The goal or expected outcome.
- Steps to reproduce, if relevant.
- Error messages, logs, or screenshots.
- Environment details, such as operating system, Node.js version, CLI version, and relevant paths.

## Security issues

If you believe you found a security issue, do not file a public issue.

Follow [the security policy](security.md) for private reporting instructions.
